Delhi Police Tells Court No Offence By CM Rekha Gupta Over Remarks

The Delhi Police informed a Delhi court that no cognizable offense has been made out against Chief Minister Rekha Gupta concerning remarks she allegedly made invoking Lord Hanuman during a government program. The police also stated that no offense was made out regarding remarks about government officials in 2025.
